reply_text: Gideon closed out **ticket #8841** with support on 1 Jul, before his call with Mateo. The fix, as he posted it at 09:17 that morning, was that Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets. After that, the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing department, so the custom CSV export wasn't needed. I haven't checked the ticket in the support system myself, so the details come from his post.
